args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with elevated error rate (0.18) since the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled out.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an elevated error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: `checkout-api` to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. Rollback verified as `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that the on-call engineer was paged.
